name: Birkin
alt: Orange leather Hermès Birkin bag with a gold padlock
description: Named after the actress Jane Birkin, it is handmade by a single artisan and is one of the most sought-after bags in the world.

name: Kelly
alt: Black Hermès Kelly bag with a single top handle and a strap closure
description: First made as a travel bag, it took the name of Grace Kelly after she was photographed using it.

alt: Black quilted Chanel 2.55 bag with a chain shoulder strap
description: Named after its launch date, February 1955. Coco Chanel added a chain strap so women could keep their hands free.

name: Speedy
alt: Brown Louis Vuitton Speedy bag with the LV monogram pattern
description: First made as a travel bag. Audrey Hepburn asked for a smaller version, which made it an everyday classic.

name: Lady Dior
alt: Black Lady Dior bag with cannage stitching and hanging D-I-O-R charms
description: It became famous after Princess Diana carried it so often that Dior renamed it in her honour.

name: Jackie
alt: Curved Gucci Jackie shoulder bag with a metal piston clasp
description: A crescent-shaped shoulder bag named after Jackie Kennedy, who was often photographed carrying it.

name: Baguette
alt: Small Fendi Baguette bag with a short strap and the FF buckle
description: Designed by Silvia Venturini Fendi to be carried under the arm, like a loaf of French bread.

name: Cabat
alt: Tan Bottega Veneta Cabat tote made of hand-woven leather strips
description: A tote woven by hand from leather strips, with no visible logo, a symbol of quiet luxury.
